component: mailnews compose error definitions and message mapping

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entries 2080–2087 remove retired compose error codes from their C++/JS definitions, error-to-string maps and localization entries. The series covers file-open 12500, temporary-file 12501, no-sender 12510, communications 12526, invalid From 12529, invalid identity 12530, attachment 12531 and NNTP cross-posting 12554. Some also update MAPI or shared header locations. Check all consumers and resources when retiring a code; removing one switch case does not remove validation or establish a replacement failure path. Fixed source has moved to platform nsresult-to-Fluent IDs with send-error-failed fallback, and old nsComposeStrings files are absent. This is later comparison context, not coverage of the remaining Bug 783526 series. No failure/runtime/build test ran.
title: Retire compose error identifiers across each definition and user-message map
